_about: Fixed renderings of the site's own vocabulary, per locale. The draft script hands these to the model with every batch, and a reviewer changes a term here rather than in a hundred strings. A term with no entry for a locale is the model's call. Keep the note in English: it is the reviewer's brief.

fairminter.note: Counterparty's on-chain mint contract. A proper noun on this site. ZH: BRC-20 readers know 公平铸造 (fair mint). The Counterparty contract is the 合约.

mint.note: Verb and noun: paying XCP into a fairminter for tokens. ZH: UniSat and the BRC-20 community write Mint as 铸造.

launch.note: One XCP-69 token launch, from announcement to pool. ZH: pump.fun Chinese idiom: a token is 发射 (launched); a launchpad is 发射台. Never 发行 (issuance) or 启动. Chinese pump.fun coverage says 发射 and 发币 interchangeably and frames phases as 内盘 (bonding curve) → 外盘 (DEX); Traditional coverage uses the same characters (發射, 畢業).

graduated.note: The launch sold out and its pool opened. pump.fun's sense of the word. ZH: pump.fun 内盘→外盘 vocabulary: 毕业 is the word the Chinese memecoin community uses.

refunded.note: The launch missed its soft cap and everyone was repaid.

scheduled.note: Announced, not yet open for minting. ZH: Announced on-chain, minting not open yet.

upcoming.note: Chip on a scheduled launch's card.

soft cap.note: The 69M-token sale target. Keep the loanword.

pool.note: The TOKEN/XCP AMM pool. ZH: 池 alone in tight labels. Uniswap zh-TW uses 資金池, but 流動性池 is clearer for an AMM.

LP burned.note: The pool's LP tokens were destroyed, so liquidity is locked forever. ZH: 销毁 is the one Chinese word for burn; there is no バーン/焼却 split.

holders.note: Katakana, as the Japanese crypto community writes it; 保有者 is the formal word exchanges use. ZH: UniSat and CMC China. Not 持币地址.

volume.note: The stock-market word, and what CoinMarketCap Japan uses. Zaif writes 取引高 in prose; keep 出来高 everywhere on this site. ZH: Uniswap and CMC China. UniSat writes 成交量; keep 交易量 everywhere here.

since mint.note: Return measured from the mint price. ZH: Return measured from the mint price.

all-time.note: The whole life of the market, as a window label beside 24h. ZH: CMC/Uniswap range label. As the window beside 24h on a card, 全期 fits where space is tight.

performance.note: Return as a percentage, the way CMC labels it.

limit.note: Limit orders on Counterparty's order book (the nav label).

dispense.note: Buying XCP from Counterparty dispensers (the nav label). ZH: The nav label for buying XCP from Counterparty dispensers.

dispenser.note: DECIDED 2026-09-07: 分发器. No Chinese Counterparty community text uses any one word; press wrote 分配器 once (Sohu) and vending-machine explainers say 自动售货机. 分发器 (distributor) reads correctly for “send BTC, receive XCP” and fits a nav label; 分配器 means an allocator in Chinese software.

docs.note: Taiwan and Hong Kong say 文件 for documentation; the mainland says 文档.

rewards.note: The XCP Rewards programme for minters.

mempool.note: Taiwan says 記憶體 for memory; Hong Kong and the mainland say 内存.

connect.note: Connect a wallet. ZH: Connect a wallet: 连接钱包 on Uniswap and UniSat. OpenCC turns 连接 into 連線 for Taiwan, which is the network sense; keep 連接.

all-time high.note: Keep the Latin abbreviation the community uses; CMC Japan writes 過去最高値. ZH: CMC China writes 历史最高价; ATH is also understood but the Chinese is the norm.

send.note: Moving an asset between addresses. Zaif and the wider community say 送金; 送付 is for documents.

miner fee.note: The Bitcoin fee. Zaif calls its withdrawal network fee 送金手数料, but on this site the fee goes to miners, not to us. ZH: UniSat writes 网络费用 for the network fee; on this site the fee goes to miners, so 矿工费.

burn.note: DECIDED 2026-09-07: Japanese press heads the term as バーン（焼却）everywhere (CoinPost glossary, Coincheck, CoinDesk Japan), so バーン is used for every burn on the site including LP バーン済み; 破棄 is kept only for Counterparty’s destroy message, where consensus destroys escrowed supply after a refund. Chinese is 销毁 in every sense; OpenCC emits 銷燬 and the derivation script restores 銷毀.

base currency.note: XCP as Counterparty’s native currency. Zaif’s own wording in its asset guide.

transaction.note: A Bitcoin transaction. A fill or trade is 成交, so the two never share a word in one sentence.

escrow.note: XCP held by the protocol until the launch resolves.

dumper.note: An address that sold within blocks of graduation.

rug pull.note: The community word; 拉地毯 is a calque nobody uses.

Bitcoin.note: BTC stays BTC as a ticker.

Counterparty.note: Always Latin. Chinese press writes Counterparty 协议; never 交易对手 (the finance word, seen in one machine-translated Sohu piece). 合约币 was the 2014 Chinese press name for XCP (8BTC) and is not used today.

proof of burn.note: Chinese press: 销毁证明 (PoB). Japanese press: プルーフ・オブ・バーン.
